title: Archiving deactivates and unenrolls; restoring enrolls nobody
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. Seed a maintenance schedule (standard steps):
  4. ↳ In Settings > Maintenance click New schedule; the "Untitled schedule" editor opens.
  5. ↳ Inline-edit the title to a test name (e.g. "Highway Tractor PM").
  6. ↳ Click Add service, give it a name (e.g. "PM-A") and a calendar interval (e.g. Every 3 months), and save the service.
  7. ↳ Click Save on the schedule.
  8. Enrol an asset (standard steps):
  9. ↳ Open Customers, open a test customer (e.g. "Aacrest Works"), open its Assets tab and open an asset (e.g. unit 402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia).
  10. ↳ Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes) and click Enroll in Schedule.
  11. ↳ Pick the schedule (e.g. "Highway Tractor PM"), leave the last service dates blank unless the case says otherwise, and click Enroll.
custom_steps:
1. Open the row menu of "Highway Tractor PM" and look for any Delete.
  2. On "Highway Tractor PM" open the row menu > Archive; read the confirmation text and its action button.
  3. Confirm. Open the asset's Maintenance tab and click Enroll in Schedule; look for "Highway Tractor PM" in the list.
  4. In Settings open the Archived tab and choose Restore on the schedule; then reopen the asset's Maintenance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The row menu offers Edit, Duplicate and Archive; there is no Delete.
  • The confirmation reads exactly "Archiving deactivates the schedule. All assets enrolled in the schedule will be unenrolled." and its red action reads "Archive Schedule".
  • The asset is no longer enrolled, and the archived schedule is not offered for enrolment.
  • After Restore the schedule can be picked again, but the asset is still not enrolled until someone enrolls it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10563 (S6, Edit and archive a schedule), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S6 (Archiving and restoring; S6-R5 to S6-R8); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), artboard E06; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R5: “A schedule can be archived, never deleted”
  • S6-R6: “The confirmation says so in these words: Archiving deactivates the schedule. All assets enrolled in the schedule will be unenrolled. Its action is red”
  • S6-R7: “An archived schedule cannot be applied to new assets”
  • S6-R8: “Restoring an archived schedule makes it available to enrol again. It enrols nothing: the assets archiving unenrolled stay unenrolled until someone enrols them again”
  • Design board, artboard E06: “Archive Schedule”
